```{r load libraries}
library(Seurat) 
library(tidyverse)
library(writexl)
library(DESeq2)
```


```{r Load the integrated file}

data <- readRDS("/Volumes/My Passport/Final Data/HarmonyIntegrated_annotated_data_final.rds")

# filter
#change filter conditions based on the file
seu.filtered <- subset(data, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 &
                         nCount_RNA > 800 & 
                         percent.mt < 5 
)

# run Seurat's standard workflow steps
seu.filtered <- NormalizeData(seu.filtered)
seu.filtered <- FindVariableFeatures(seu.filtered)
seu.filtered <- ScaleData(seu.filtered)
seu.filtered <- RunPCA(seu.filtered)
seu.filtered <- RunUMAP(seu.filtered, dims = 1:20)

```

```{r preparing the counts matrix for pseudobulk comparison}
seu.filtered$CellTypes <- Idents(seu.filtered)

# pseudo-bulk workflow -----------------
# Acquiring necessary metrics for aggregation across cells in a sample
# 1. counts matrix - sample level
# counts aggregate to sample level
#see if we need to do this 

seu.filtered$samples <- paste0(seu.filtered$orig.ident, seu.filtered$CellTypes)

cts <- AggregateExpression(seu.filtered, 
                           group.by = c("CellTypes", "sample"),
                           assays = 'RNA',
                           slot = "counts",
                           return.seurat = FALSE)

cts <- cts$RNA

# transpose
cts.t <- t(cts)

# convert to data.frame
cts.t <- as.data.frame(cts.t)

# get values where to split
splitRows <- gsub('_.*', '', rownames(cts.t))

# split data.frame
cts.split <- split.data.frame(cts.t,
                              f = factor(splitRows))

# fix colnames and transpose
cts.split.modified <- lapply(cts.split, function(x){
  rownames(x) <- gsub('.*_(.*)_', '\\1', rownames(x))
  t(x)
  
})


```


```{r DESeq2 MNN}
# Let's run DE analysis with Multiciliated
# 1. Get counts matrix
counts_mnn <- cts.split.modified$`Multiciliated (non-nasal)`

#2 generate sample level metadata - do it for each "control" sample vs "treated" sample   

condition <- factor(c("copd", "copd", "copd", "copd", "copd", "nonsmoker", "nonsmoker", "nonsmoker", "smoker", "smoker", "smoker"))

mnn_coldata <- data.frame(row.names = colnames(counts_mnn), condition)

# Set factor level
mnn_coldata$condition <- relevel(mnn_coldata$condition, ref = "nonsmoker") 

# perform DESeq2 --------
# Create DESeq2 object   
mnn_dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts_mnn,
                                  colData = mnn_coldata,
                                  design = ~ condition)

# filter
keep <- rowSums(counts(mnn_dds)) >=10
mnn_dds <- mnn_dds[keep,]

# run DESeq2
mnn_dds <- DESeq(mnn_dds)

# Generate results object
res01 <- results(mnn_dds, name = "condition_copd_vs_nonsmoker")
summary(res01)

write.csv(as.data.frame(res01), file="/Users/gagandeepkaur/Desktop/COPD Paper - Revision 2/Figure 8/copd_vs_ns_mnn.csv")
saveRDS(res01, "/Users/gagandeepkaur/Desktop/COPD Paper - Revision 2/Figure 8/copd_vs_ns_mnn.rds")

Sig_res01 <- subset(res01, padj < 0.05)
summary(Sig_res01)
head(Sig_res01)
write.csv(as.data.frame(Sig_res01), file="/Users/gagandeepkaur/Desktop/COPD Paper - Revision 2/Figure 8/copd_vs_ns_mnn_sig.csv")


res02 <- results(mnn_dds, name = "condition_smoker_vs_nonsmoker")
summary(res02)

saveRDS(res02, "/Users/gagandeepkaur/Desktop/COPD Paper - Revision 2/Figure 8/sm_vs_ns_mnn.rds")
write.csv(as.data.frame(res02), file="/Users/gagandeepkaur/Desktop/COPD Paper - Revision 2/Figure 8/sm_vs_ns_mnn.csv")

# Set factor level to smoker
mnn_coldata$condition <- relevel(mnn_coldata$condition, ref = "smoker") 

# perform DESeq2 --------
# Create DESeq2 object   
mnn_dds_1 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts_mnn,
                                    colData = mnn_coldata,
                                    design = ~ condition)


# filter
keep <- rowSums(counts(mnn_dds_1)) >=10
mnn_dds_1 <- mnn_dds_1[keep,]

# run DESeq2
mnn_dds_1 <- DESeq(mnn_dds_1)

# Generate results object
res03 <- results(mnn_dds_1, name = "condition_copd_vs_smoker")
summary(res03)

write.csv(as.data.frame(res03), file="/Users/gagandeepkaur/Desktop/COPD Paper - Revision 2/Figure 8/copd_vs_sm_mnn.csv")
saveRDS(res03, "/Users/gagandeepkaur/Desktop/COPD Paper - Revision 2/Figure 8/copd_vs_sm_mnn.rds")

write.csv(as.data.frame(counts_mnn), file="/Users/gagandeepkaur/Desktop/COPD Paper - Revision 2/Figure 8/counts_mnn.csv")

```

```{r Z score}
# Z-scores of important parameters

mat_1 <- counts(mnn_dds, normalized = T)[rownames(Sig_res01),]
```
